entries.note: His words are only 'there's nothing left afterwards'. The drafter added 'in the tech industry' and 'as a growth driver', which makes the claim more specific than what he wrote, and readers would disagree on what 'nothing left' means.

entries.test: Whether major US stock indexes, or tech and AI stocks, fell by a meaningful amount when a widely recognised collapse of the AI investment boom happened.
entries.note: The surrounding text, about his anxiety over the bubble popping, supports reading this as conditional on the bubble popping. The trigger itself is loosely defined.

entries.test: Layoff trackers, such as Layoffs.fyi and Challenger reports, showing tens of thousands of job losses tied to an AI bubble collapse.
entries.note: In context, the job losses he means are most likely in tech.

entries.test: Whether a long, severe downturn in tech-sector revenue, investment and employment followed a collapse of the AI boom.
entries.note: 'Depression' is loose wording, but most readers would take it to mean a long and severe downturn in the tech sector.
